review.subject: Sale template: folded fleece in six colours over a fixed percent-off banner
review.summary: One locked top-down camera on a cream floor with the banner text on screen from frame 1. Folded items appear one by one (about 0.4s apart), hold as a full set for 3.6s, then leave in reverse so it loops. No camera move and no cuts inside the set; the build is the motion.

learn: For a sale template, put the offer text on screen from frame 1 and keep it fixed for the whole clip; only the products move.
Build the flat-lay one item per 0.4s with the camera locked, hold the full set for about half the runtime (3.6s of 6.8s), then remove items in reverse so the clip loops.
Use one colour per item and a plain cream floor so the colours carry the frame; the banner should be white with a soft shadow, centred, about 12% of the frame width in height.
Keep a sale template to 6-7s: a short loop plays back as a seamless, scroll-stopping repeat.
